summary: Client game WoW 1.12.1 được viết từ đầu bằng Rust và Bevy, cung cấp trải nghiệm WoW tùy chỉnh.
usecases: Run a customized private WoW server with modified gameplay.
Study and learn game client architecture and Rust/Bevy game development.
Create private WoW realms with specific rule sets and content.
ideas: Build a cross-platform WoW modding framework using Bevy plugins.
Develop a WoW client analytics dashboard tracking player behavior and server performance.
Port the client to run natively on Linux/macOS/Windows with enhanced graphics via Bevy.
